$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 57 (status view). Declared before the work. WHAT THESE CANNOT EXPRESS: that the report is USEFUL -- that an operator reading it can tell what governance will and will not do here. A command_exit proves it exits 0, never that it said anything worth reading. The conformance check below is the closest mechanical proxy: it asserts an unbound role is REPORTED rather than omitted, which is the absence-versus-unknown distinction ADR-008 C4 already makes for adapters.
